notes.title: Underground Garage Release Date Announcement + Demo
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Big news! If you loved Biker Garage, you're going to be thrilled with its successor—Underground Garage! 

We are officially launching in Early Access on October 24, 2024! Mark your calendars, because this fall, it’s time to hit the pavement and dominate the underground racing scene. 🏎️💨

To kick off the excitement, we’ve dropped a brand-new release date trailer! It’s packed with action, high-stakes racing, and a glimpse of the adrenaline-pumping world waiting for you. 🔥 Watch it here:
[previewyoutube=uGyTdRWBJx8;full][/previewyoutube]

But wait, there's more! You can dive in today with our new demo now live on Steam! Get a taste of what it's like to wrench, tune, and customize your ride into a race-ready machine. Whether you're perfecting your engine or adding that perfect street racer flair, we can't wait for you to experience it all firsthand.

-> PLAY THE DEMO <- 

Don’t forget to wishlist Underground Garage on Steam to be the first in line when we hit Early Access!

Let’s build something amazing together!
—The Underground Garage Team

notes.title: New Update - the tutorial!
notes.notes:
Hi Bikers!

Long time no see! In this update, we’re bringing you an in-game tutorial to help some less advanced mechanics get their garage started :)

We want everyone to have fun when playing the game, and we know the beginning of the game can sometimes be quite overwhelming. Showing you some basic steps at the start will make the experience much more pleasant! 

In the tutorial, you will learn how to get commissions, get acquainted with the tools you have at your disposal in the garage, and learn the basics of the repair mechanism. Of course, there are still things to be discovered later, but it will give you an excellent head start and introduction to the game :)

notes.title: New Update - bug fixes. And Summer Sale :) Discount 60%!
notes.notes:
Hey!

We've recently made improvements to the game based on our Flow Analyze Machine tool and from bugs reported by you. We hope they will improve your perception of the game!


 Highlight on the door with information that it can be unlocked by doing more missions.
 Highlighting of parts at the dump (mapped the same as the highlighting of parts in the garage)
 Improved text readability above the paint shop (added dark shadow)
 Fixed running on the pad
 Fixed problem with painting without selected color
 Disabling circular menu when launching the tablet
 Fixed bug reported recently by a player - due to a broken part in the save he could not use the paint shop
 Fixed bug in incorrect part saving preventing use of paint shop
 Fixed incorrect behavior of the status display when switching the pause menu on and off
 Removed barely visible debug reset button in paint view

Also - new motorcycles, language fixes, console versions and new languages coming soon. It's going to happen :)

In the meantime, we invite you to participate in the Summer Sale - 60% off!

notes.title: Biker Garage Anniversary Update - Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Hey, Bikers!

It’s been a long time coming, but we’re finally able to announce that in mid-December, a new version will be released as the Biker Garage Anniversary Update and it’s gonna be big! As you all probably already know the most important change will be the new interface, but that’s not it! We’ve also fixed the bugs reported by you in the past months.

Here are some of the bugs that have been fixed:


 Filtering the wishlist by category in the store we are in
 You can repair parts that are below 20%, contrary to what the tutorial and help section suggest
 You can drain the brake fluid to many liters in the minus. Additionally, the target amount may be -1 for a second
 You can paint a part with multiple colors and when you finish, the color of the whole part will change to the last one you’ve selected
 On weaker computers, the dynamometer does not display the generated information
 You can get stuck in the junkyard, due to the player's character falling very slowly
 The technical condition of all motorcycles in the parking lot shows 0%
 Incorrect speed measurement on the track
 Some parts fall below the junkyard and fall perpetually
 The tires have normal maps turned upside down and they shine too much

notes.title: Bug fixes after the latest update
notes.notes:
Hi, in the latest updates we fixed the following bugs, we hope that the game got better and you’re building great motorcycles :)


1. A fix to unlock the purchase of parts at the junkyard
2. A fix to unlock the purchase of motorcycles at the junkyard
3. A fix of the bug that caused showing incorrect damage to engines
4. A new controller added (improved movement around the garage)
5. Descriptions, of what the particular stores contain, added
6. Interface fix - Hiding material customization behind a separate button
7. A fix of the bug that caused showing incorrect parts icons during sale
8. Gameplay fix - the paint shop is available from the beginning of the game
9. Improvements to the Sport CR9 motorcycle
10. Improvements to the Sport 9Z motorcycle
11. Interface fix – customization of particular parts blocked (brake pads, drive belt etc.)
12. Improvements to new seat models for Chopper Long Fork
13. Translation correction of the drive belt in Chopper Black
14. Correction of the drive belt material in Chopper Black
15. A fix for falling under the map

Kind regards,
Marcelina

notes.title: Build Your Bike! Customization Update Available NOW!
notes.notes:

FROM NOW, YOU CAN CUSTOMIZE YOUR BIKES and BUILD MOTORCYCLE FROM YOUR IMAGINATION! Check what we prepared for you:

If you enjoy it, share it with your friends :) If you don't have Biker Garage: Mechanic Simulator, buy it now with 44% Discount on Summer Sale!

Important info: it's a big change in the entire game, so we recommend to start New game after the update. We did our best to make old saves working fine, but a better option is to start the new game. If you start your old saves and have any problems, please contact us on our Discord(on support channel): https://discord.gg/F9N4tep or directly to lukasz@beardedbrothers.games.

We know that a lot of you are waiting for this announcement. You said that is the most crucial feature that you don't see in the game - the possibility to make a unique look of your motorcycle. 


What are we adding to the game? 


 Hundreds of new, unique parts for motorcycles,
 New textures for tires, 
 New versions for actual parts (including chromed parts),
 Possibility to use some parts between bikes,
 Two new sports bikes!

notes.title: Roadmap Update
notes.notes:
Hello!

We have received a lot of feedback from you and thank you for that. 
You told us about the problems you have when you are working on a motorcycle and according to your suggestions we decided to improve this part of the game. Because we are working on issues that bother you the most, the dates from the roadmap may change. Some content will appear sooner and some later, so that your game needs are met as soon as possible. Motorcycles will appear as planned. We will be adding 1 motorcycle per month.
